text: I saw an ad on Novamir Jobs Abroad promising hotel work in Japan through Pexalon Overseas Pvt. Ltd. A man named Kiran said he’d secure my visa and job. He asked me to pay an insurance deposit then a medical test fee using IME Pay wallet ID 966555921—totaling NPR 181,500. After the second payment, his phones (+977988555339 and 972-555-594) went dead and he disappeared. I’m stranded without work or savings. Please investigate urgently before others get tricked too. Police case needed now.

I am writing to report being cheated by a fake loan app called Sorenta Paisa on 24 January 2026. I got a message through SMS saying I could get instant loan easily. The message had a link which I clicked – sorenta-loan-97.example. It opened something like an app page. They said my loan of Rs 25,000 was approved but I need to pay processing fee first. I believed them because many apps ask small fees these days.

They told me to send NPR 2,000 to their eSewa wallet. I did so using +977983555600. After that they said there were more charges and I should send another NPR 5,000. Then again they asked for NPR 15,000 saying it was insurance or guarantee. In total I sent NPR 22,000 over two days. Each time they promised the loan will come soon after payment.

But after last payment they stopped replying properly. Instead they started sending threatening messages every day from number 974555199. They said if I don’t pay more they will expose my details or take legal action. I felt scared but also knew something was wrong. I have not received any loan money at all.

I am a simple housewife trying to manage home expenses. I thought this could help during tight month. Now I lost money and am getting threats. Dherai chinta lagi cha. Kindly please help me trace these people and return my money if possible. I have screenshots of chats and transaction proofs ready to show. Thank you for your time and support. Jai Nepal.

Hello sir/madam, I am writing to report a big problem. On 27th May 2026, around evening time, I got a video call from someone saying he is Inspector Shrestha from Central Investigation Bureau. The number showed +977968555656 and also another number 989555737 later when he insisted to keep talking.

He said there is a parcel in my name at airport with illegal drugs inside and if I don’t pay security deposit then I will be arrested digitally. He kept me on video call for almost three hours, yelling and showing fake papers on screen. He looked serious, wore uniform kind of thing. I got scared, mind went blank. He demanded I send money through IME Pay to clear my name, said it’s refundable after check. I sent NPR 350,000 to wallet ID 980555509 because he said if I delay, court case will start and my family will suffer.

After sending, he disconnected call. Next day I tried to call back but numbers were switched off. I feel so stupid and scared now. Please help me catch this fake inspector. I am a student, just trying to study, why did they target me? Dhanyabad for listening. I hope justice comes soon. Namaskar.

Hello sir/madam,

On 26 June 2026 I joined a Telegram group named @brivax_signals_8651 where they shared daily crypto trading signals. At first I saw good profits on their website brivax-trade-62.example/download – my balance doubled in two weeks. But when I tried to withdraw, they froze my account and demanded an unlock fee. The admin contacted me via WhatsApp using numbers +977981555062 and +977-975-555-819 asking me to send more money through eSewa wallet 981555871. I paid but still could not get my funds back. I have lost around NPR 154,500 total. Please help me recover my money and catch these fraudsters. I am very worried and need assistance urgently. Thank you.

I am writing because my aunt got tricked online. She met someone on Instagram who said she is a businesswoman in Canada. The scammer said they were sending a box with jewellery and a phone but asked for customs fee first. My aunt paid NPR 68,500 on 28 July 2026 but nothing came. The scammer messaged from 987 555 488. Please help us. We are confused and don’t know what to do now. We hope you can find them and get our money back. Thank you.

I saw an ad on Facebook page Orlenta Second Hand Market selling gold jewelry. On 5th July 2026 I messaged them they said need booking deposit so I send NPR 1500 via eSewa wallet ID +977989555343 then they ask more charge another NPR 12000 after paying again they say custom fee NPR 12500 still nothing came now total loss NPR 29500 they stopped replying please help me get my money back im very angry and feel cheated all time waiting but got nothing

Hello sir, on 20th May 2026 I saw an ad online selling a second-hand motorbike. The seller asked me to pay a booking deposit via mobile banking before viewing it. After sending NPR 31,000 to his number (+977960555296), he started demanding extra charges—delivery fee, registration tax—and then went silent. This thag lagaunu hunxa! Please track him down and return my paisa. I am very upset and need justice. Help me, dhanyabad.

I am writing because I got tricked and need help. On 24th May 2026, around morning time, I got a call on my mobile from a number showing 965-555-978. The man said he was from telecom security office. He spoke in Hindi accent but knew some Nepali too. He told me my citizenship card details were stolen and someone opened bank accounts using my name in India. Then he sent something on WhatsApp - looked like an arrest paper with government logo and stamps. It had my photo and ID number. He said unless I pay verification money, police will come take me today itself. I got very scared thinking about my wife and son at home alone. He asked me to send NPR 371,000 to a certain bank account saying it's refundable after check. I did it through mobile banking hoping it will clear my name. Later when I tried calling back, number was switched off. Now I realize it was fake. Please help find who did this. I don't have much savings left now and fear more calls. My hands still shake remembering his threats. Please act fast before others get hurt too. Thank you for listening.

Hello sir/madam,

On 20 June 2026, I saw gold jewellery on the Facebook page 'Orlenta Second Hand Market'. The seller asked me to send an eSewa wallet transfer of NPR 5,000 as a booking deposit to their number 964-555-230. After sending, they said there were extra handling fees and taxes and insisted I pay more through calls from 989-555-670. Each time I transferred more — finally totaling NPR 27,500 — they gave new excuses but never shipped anything. Now my husband says *paise kharch garne* was foolish and I feel so *dukhiyani*, worried we won’t have enough for next month’s ration. Please help track them down. I don’t want others to suffer like this. Thank you.

I saw an ad on YouTube for Marivo Loan app on Baishakh 24, 2083. It promised fast loan so I applied and got NPR 2,000 approved quickly. But next day they asked me to pay back NPR 11,500 saying it included fees and interest. I tried to explain but they started calling my contacts from numbers 975-555-698 and 979555291, telling them I am a fraudster. Feeling scared and harassed, I transferred money to their Khalti wallet ID 978-555-540 through the app link marivo-loan-33.example/app to stop the calls. Now I have lost NPR 11,500 and feel helpless. Please help me take action against this fake loan app. Dhanayabad.

I am writing because I got scammed on 30 August 2026. I saw gold jewellery listed on the Facebook page called Orlenta Second Hand Market by someone named Mr. Adhikari. He said he needed a booking deposit so I sent NPR 18,500 to Trelisa Bikas Bank account number 6004 7974 8016 2456 under Manoj S. After that he kept asking for more money but never gave me anything. I am just a shopkeeper trying to support my family and now I have nothing left from my savings. Please help me get justice. The seller is still active online and might trick others too. Thank you.
